ModManifest.Name: Waifu Bar
ModManifest.Author: kuekue
ModManifest.Description: Adds the Waifu Bar as an after-hours location: Kara sells mystery boxes with 69 collectible anime figures, and on weekends Yuna runs the bar with a happy hour. Collect and level up figures, put them in your shop window, become a Waifu Collector, sell to the Collector Geek and appraise his figures with the magnifier.
